name: Sex Underworld e Youkoso!
original_name: セックスアンダーワールドへようこそ！
source:
The hero from another world successfully made children with his seven wives.
It seemed that this was the end of his fateful mission.

In the world of Laurentide, the people whispered of an ancient legend.

──When the Heroes of Light are born, the Children of Darkness are also born──

The man who would father those figures, is the hero himself.

"Again, really!?" the hero thinks to himself, despite being eager to have more sex.
In fact, if he becomes the father of the heroes of light and the Children of Darkness, it is possible for him become something that surpasses even the king of the world.

So therefore...

Guided by a legend, from places never seen before, beautiful girls from the underworld gather in search of the hero's seed.

...Perhaps they come with dark desires hidden in their hearts.
...Or perhaps, they just want to have sex with the hero.

The hero's days of being wrung dry by beautiful girls begin again...

[Translated from the Official Website]
translation:
来自另一个世界的英雄与他的七个妻子成功生下了孩子。
看来他的宿命使命到此结束了。

在劳伦泰德的世界里，人们低声议论着一个古老的传说。

──当光之英雄诞生时，黑暗之子也随之诞生──

那些人物的父亲就是英雄本人。

“再说一次，真的吗！？”尽管英雄渴望有更多的性行为，但他却在心里想着。
事实上，如果他成为了光明英雄和黑暗之子的父亲，他就有可能成为超越世界之王的人物。

所以所以…

在传说的指引下，来自地狱的美丽女孩们从前所未见的地方聚集在一起，寻找英雄的种子。

……也许他们的内心深处隐藏着黑暗的欲望。
……或许，他们只是想和英雄发生性关系。

英雄被美少女榨干的日子又开始了……
